mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.parent_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.route_path, m.icon_name, m.sort_order, m.enabled FROM app_menu m JOIN app_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id JOIN app_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.enabled = 1 AND m.enabled = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_code
